svg.title: AuraProj daily change reference for 2026-07-27
svg.desc: Graph execution context and mana routing.
svg.text: 2026-07-27 - Graph context and mana routing
main | 1 commit: b99e948
Daily job
Make graph execution carry its own definition and express mana cost through GAS.
Definition context, Sequence recursion, and SetByCaller GameplayEffect cost application changed.
BEFORE
Hidden execution dependencies
Tasks did not consistently carry Definition.
Sequence recursion could re-enter incorrectly.
Mana was not expressed as a normal GAS cost.
Graph nodes depended on implicit state.
AFTER
Definition and resource data travel with execution
Ability Definition is threaded through node/task context.
Sequence recursion is corrected so composition does not re-enter itself incorrectly.
Mana cost routes through a SetByCaller GameplayEffect.
Graph resource changes now align with GAS resource modification.
Guard: the graph does not manually subtract mana outside the GAS effect.
Important guard
Definition is explicit context, not global state.
Mana follows the same authority/resource rules
as other GameplayEffects.
Validation / newcomer path
Trace Definition into context and Sequence.
Then trace the SetByCaller GE into the ASC;
do not look for a node-local mana subtraction.
